text.p: Caribiner International Inc Tuesday said it acquired all of the outstanding stock of Rome Network Inc for a combination of cash and Caribiner common stock. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The acquisition expands Caribiner's client list and capacity to offer business communications services which range from meeting and event production, training programs and exhibit design to audiovisual equipment rental, Caribiner said. As a result of the acquisition, Caribiner will expand and strengthen its presence in the business communications services market in San Francisco.
Rome Network is a leading regional provider of business communications services in the San Francisco area.
